/// Decides which areas of a self intersecting or multi contour `Path` count as
/// inside when it is filled.
/// ```as
/// let path = new Path();
/// path.fillRule = FillRule.evenOdd;
/// ```
export const enum FillRule {
    /// Inside where the contours wind around a point a nonzero number of times.
    nonZero = 0,

    /// Inside where a ray from a point crosses the contours an odd number of times.
    evenOdd = 1,

    /// Inside where the contours wind clockwise around a point. The default.
    clockwise = 2,
}

/// The verb bytes a `Path` stores, one per command, as passed to
/// `Path.appendRaw` and `Path.fromRaw`.
export const enum PathVerb {
    /// Starts a new contour. Takes 1 point.
    move = 0,

    /// A straight line. Takes 1 point.
    line = 1,

    /// A quadratic Bézier curve. Takes 2 points, the control point and the end.
    quad = 2,

    /// A cubic Bézier curve. Takes 3 points, two control points and the end.
    cubic = 4,

    /// Closes the contour. Takes no points.
    close = 5,
}

/// A mutable path that a `Renderer` can draw. An unchanged path can be drawn
/// multiple times per frame. However, if you change it (with `moveTo`,
/// `lineTo`, `cubicTo`, `add` and so on) after drawing it, wait until the next
/// frame to draw it again.
///
/// A path is also a list of `PathCommand` values, from `path[0]` to
/// `path[path.length - 1]`, that `for...of` walks in order.
/// ```as
/// let path = new Path();
/// path.moveTo(Vector.xy(0, 0));
/// path.lineTo(Vector.xy(10, 0));
///
/// for (const command of path) {
///   console.log(command.type);
/// }
/// // moveTo
/// // lineTo
/// ```
export class Path {
    /// How the path decides what is inside when filled, see `FillRule`. Defaults
    /// to `clockwise`.
    get fillRule(): FillRule;
    set fillRule(value: FillRule);

    /// The number of commands in the path.
    /// ```as
    /// let count = path.length;
    /// ```
    get length(): i32;

    /// The command at `index`, from 0 to `length - 1`. An index out of range
    /// returns a command of type `none` with no points.
    /// ```as
    /// let first = path[0];
    /// console.log(first.type);
    /// ```
    operator[](index: i32): PathCommand;

    /// Moves the current point to `to`, starting a new contour.
    /// ```as
    /// path.moveTo(Vector.xy(0, 0));
    /// ```
    moveTo(to: Vector): void;

    /// Adds a straight line from the current point to `to`. Without an open
    /// contour, one starts at the last `moveTo` point, or at the origin on an empty
    /// path.
    /// ```as
    /// path.lineTo(Vector.xy(10, 0));
    /// ```
    lineTo(to: Vector): void;

    /// Adds a quadratic Bézier curve from the current point to `to`, shaped by
    /// `control`.
    /// ```as
    /// path.quadTo(
    ///   Vector.xy(-50, -50), // control point
    ///   Vector.xy(0, 0) // end point
    /// );
    /// ```
    quadTo(control: Vector, to: Vector): void;

    /// Adds a cubic Bézier curve from the current point to `to`, using
    /// `controlOut` for the start tangent and `controlIn` for the end tangent.
    /// ```as
    /// path.cubicTo(
    ///   Vector.xy(25, -40), // control point out
    ///   Vector.xy(75, 40), // control point in
    ///   Vector.xy(100, 0) // end point
    /// );
    /// ```
    cubicTo(controlOut: Vector, controlIn: Vector, to: Vector): void;

    /// Closes the current contour with a line from the current point back to its
    /// first point, the last `moveTo`. Does nothing without an open contour.
    /// ```as
    /// // A square
    /// path.moveTo(Vector.xy(-10, -10));
    /// path.lineTo(Vector.xy(10, -10));
    /// path.lineTo(Vector.xy(10, 10));
    /// path.lineTo(Vector.xy(-10, 10));
    /// path.close();
    /// ```
    close(): void;

    /// Removes every command so the path can be rebuilt. Do not reset a path in
    /// the same frame after drawing it; wait until the next frame.
    /// ```as
    /// path.reset();
    /// ```
    reset(): void;

    /// Appends the commands of `other` onto this path, transformed by `transform`
    /// when given.
    /// ```as
    /// let dst = new Path();
    /// let src = new Path();
    ///
    /// src.moveTo(Vector.xy(0, 0));
    /// src.lineTo(Vector.xy(10, 0));
    /// src.lineTo(Vector.xy(10, 10));
    /// src.close();
    ///
    /// dst.add(src);
    /// dst.add(src, Mat2D.withTranslation(20, 0));
    /// ```
    unsafe add(other: Path, transform: Mat2D = Mat2D()): void;

    /// Returns a new path built from raw geometry: `verbCount` `PathVerb` bytes at
    /// `verbs` and `floatCount` interleaved x and y floats at `points`.
    unsafe static fromRaw(
        verbs: usize,
        verbCount: u32,
        points: usize,
        floatCount: u32
    ): Path;

    /// Appends raw geometry in bulk: `verbCount` `PathVerb` bytes at `verbs` and
    /// `floatCount` interleaved x and y floats at `points`. Later commands continue
    /// the contour the raw geometry leaves open.
    /// ```as
    /// // A line from 0, 0 to 10, 0, closed
    /// unsafe function appendLine(path: Path): void {
    ///   let verbs = new StaticArray<u8>(3);
    ///   verbs[0] = <u8>PathVerb.move;
    ///   verbs[1] = <u8>PathVerb.line;
    ///   verbs[2] = <u8>PathVerb.close;
    ///   let points = new StaticArray<f32>(4);
    ///   points[2] = 10;
    ///   path.appendRaw(changetype<usize>(verbs), 3, changetype<usize>(points), 4);
    /// }
    /// ```
    unsafe appendRaw(
        verbs: usize,
        verbCount: u32,
        points: usize,
        floatCount: u32
    ): void;

    /// Returns a `PathMeasure` over the whole path across all contours, for its
    /// total length and operations on the path as a whole.
    /// ```as
    /// let measure = path.measure();
    /// let pathLength = measure.length;
    /// ```
    unsafe measure(): PathMeasure;

    /// Returns a `ContourMeasure` for the first contour in the path, or `null` if
    /// the path has none. A contour is a sequence of segments starting at a
    /// `moveTo` and ending before the next `moveTo` or the end of the path. Read
    /// `next` on the result to walk the rest.
    /// ```as
    /// let contour = path.contours();
    /// while (contour != null) {
    ///   console.log(contour.length.toString());
    ///   contour = contour.next;
    /// }
    /// ```
    unsafe contours(): ContourMeasure?;

    /// Frees the path's host resources now instead of when it is collected.
    /// The path keeps its commands and can still be read, edited or drawn.
    release(): void;
}

/// A position and tangent pair, as returned by
/// `PathMeasure.positionAndTangent`.
export class PosTan {
    /// The position.
    v0: Vector;

    /// The normalized tangent.
    v1: Vector;
}

/// Measures a path, or one contour of it, and samples points along it.
export class PathMeasure {
    /// The total length of the measured path across all contours, or of the
    /// one contour for a `ContourMeasure`.
    /// ```as
    /// let path = new Path();
    /// path.moveTo(Vector.xy(-150, 0));
    /// path.cubicTo(Vector.xy(-80, -120), Vector.xy(80, 120), Vector.xy(150, 0));
    ///
    /// let measure = path.measure();
    /// console.log("length: " + measure.length.toString());
    /// ```
    get length(): f64;

    /// True only if the path has exactly one contour and that contour is closed.
    /// Paths with several contours are never closed, even when every contour is.
    /// For a `ContourMeasure`, whether its contour is closed.
    /// ```as
    /// let measure = path.measure();
    /// let closed = measure.isClosed;
    /// ```
    get isClosed(): bool;

    /// Returns the position and normalized tangent at `distance` along the path.
    /// The distance is clamped between 0 and `length`.
    /// ```as
    /// override draw(renderer: Renderer): void {
    ///   renderer.drawPath(this.path, this.pathPaint);
    ///
    ///   // Place a dot that travels along the path
    ///   let measure = this.path.measure();
    ///   let distance = (this.elapsed * 0.3) % 1.0 * measure.length;
    ///   let pos = measure.positionAndTangent(distance).v0;
    ///
    ///   this.traveler.reset();
    ///   drawDot(this.traveler, pos.x, pos.y, 8);
    ///   renderer.drawPath(this.traveler, this.travelerPaint);
    /// }
    /// ```
    unsafe positionAndTangent(distance: f64): PosTan;

    /// Warps a point onto the path: `source.x` is a distance along the path and
    /// `source.y` an offset along the normal there. Returns the warped position.
    /// ```as
    /// // Map a grid of points onto the path, x as distance and y as offset
    /// let measure = this.path.measure();
    /// let len = measure.length;
    /// this.warpPath.reset();
    /// let cols = 16;
    /// let rows = 3;
    /// for (let col = 0; col <= cols; col++) {
    ///   for (let row = -rows; row <= rows; row++) {
    ///     let source = Vector.xy(<f32>(<f64>col / <f64>cols * len), <f32>(row * 20));
    ///     let warped = measure.warp(source);
    ///     drawDot(this.warpPath, warped.x, warped.y, 3);
    ///   }
    /// }
    /// renderer.drawPath(this.warpPath, this.warpPaint);
    /// ```
    unsafe warp(source: Vector): Vector;

    /// Appends the section of the path between `startDistance` and `endDistance`
    /// to `destination`. Distances are clamped between 0 and `length`. When
    /// `startWithMove` is true, the default, the section starts with a `moveTo`;
    /// otherwise it continues from the last point of `destination`.
    /// ```as
    /// // A highlight window traveling along the path
    /// let measure = this.path.measure();
    /// let len = measure.length;
    /// let start = (this.elapsed * 0.3) % 1.0 * len;
    /// let end = start + len * 0.4;
    /// this.extractedPath.reset();
    /// if (end <= len) {
    ///   measure.extract(start, end, this.extractedPath);
    /// } else {
    ///   // Wrap around the end of the path
    ///   measure.extract(start, len, this.extractedPath);
    ///   measure.extract(0, end - len, this.extractedPath, false);
    /// }
    /// renderer.drawPath(this.extractedPath, this.extractPaint);
    /// ```
    unsafe extract(
        startDistance: f64,
        endDistance: f64,
        destination: Path,
        startWithMove: bool = true
    ): void;

    /// Frees the measure's host resources now instead of when it is collected. Do
    /// not use the measure afterwards.
    release(): void;
}

/// Measures a single contour of a path. A contour is one continuous sequence
/// that starts with a `moveTo` and runs until the next `moveTo` or the end of
/// the path. It extends `PathMeasure`, so it has every member of one.
export class ContourMeasure extends PathMeasure {
    /// The next contour in the path, or `null` after the last. Reading it again
    /// returns the same contour.
    /// ```as
    /// let contour = path.contours();
    /// while (contour != null) {
    ///   console.log(contour.length.toString());
    ///   contour = contour.next;
    /// }
    /// ```
    get next(): ContourMeasure?;
}

/// A single drawing command inside a `Path`: its `type` and the points that
/// type uses. It copies its points, so later edits to the path leave it
/// unchanged. `for...of` walks the points in order.
/// ```as
/// for (const command of path) {
///   for (const point of command) {
///     console.log(point.x.toString() + ", " + point.y.toString());
///   }
/// }
/// ```
export class PathCommand {
    /// The command name: `moveTo`, `lineTo`, `quadTo`, `cubicTo` or `close`, or
    /// `none` for an index past the end of the path.
    /// ```as
    /// let path = new Path();
    /// path.moveTo(Vector.xy(0, 0));
    /// path.lineTo(Vector.xy(10, 0));
    /// console.log(path[1].type); // lineTo
    /// ```
    type: string;

    /// The number of points the command uses:
    /// - `moveTo`: 1 point
    /// - `lineTo`: 1 point
    /// - `quadTo`: 2 points
    /// - `cubicTo`: 3 points
    /// - `close`: 0 points
    get length(): i32;

    /// The point at `index`, from 0 to `length - 1`. The last point is where the
    /// command ends. An index out of range returns the zero vector, where Luau
    /// returns nil.
    /// ```as
    /// let path = new Path();
    /// path.moveTo(Vector.xy(0, 0));
    /// path.cubicTo(Vector.xy(25, -40), Vector.xy(75, 40), Vector.xy(100, 0));
    ///
    /// let command = path[1];
    /// console.log(command.type); // cubicTo
    /// let end = command[command.length - 1]; // 100, 0
    /// ```
    operator[](index: i32): Vector;
}
